name: okc-dashboard
description: Make a virtual machine, set it up, snapshot it, throw it away.
//main: An app page, loaded from disk. That is what makes NW.js behave normally: the page gets node, and the SDK build gives it a right-click Inspect of its own. Served over http instead it would be a remote page, which gets neither -- which is why nothing here has to hand-write a context menu.
//chromium-args: Required. It selects the older window implementation, under which Window.get() does not exist -- so nothing here calls a window API, and dialogs are in-page overlays because native confirm() silently returns false under it.
